headline: Resilience Assessment, from entry to detail
overview: The Resilience Assessment measures your psychological resilience across multiple dimensions — how well you recover from setbacks, maintain perspective under pressure, draw on social support, and find meaning in adversity. Understanding your resilience profile helps you identify your natural strengths when facing difficulty and pinpoint the areas where you can build greater emotional fortitude.
targetAudience: Users interested in psychology tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Multi-dimensional assessment covering recovery, perspective, social support, and meaning-making
Dimension-by-dimension score breakdown revealing resilience strengths and gaps
Evidence-based insights on what drives psychological resilience
Targeted recommendations for building resilience in your lower-scoring dimensions
tips: Take the assessment during a normal period, not immediately after a crisis — your baseline is what matters most
Focus growth efforts on your lowest-scoring dimension for the most impactful resilience gains
